title: Transforming Rice Production in Flood-Affected Areas: Development of the Swarna-Sub1 Variety Using Marker-Assisted Backcrossing and its Deployment in India
version: FAO, Biotechnologies at Work for Smallholders, chapter 2.7, pp. 63–70

passages.locator: p. 64, “Discovery of flood tolerance in rice and attempts to develop tolerant varieties”
passages.quote: pure line selections such as FR13A from Dhalaputia were released in the early 1950s
passages.note: Dhalaputia was the source population for FR13A. The authors place the release of such pure-line selections in the early 1950s and describe 1970s rediscovery in IRRI screening.

passages.locator: p. 64, same section, paragraph ending “on a large scale”
passages.note: The authors describe a line ending in -1 released under the name Popoul in Cambodia in 1999, with limited uptake. Its suffix differs from the -3 donor identified by the Indian release account.

passages.locator: p. 65, “Swarna, a popular variety in rainfed lowlands”
passages.note: Describes Swarna (MTU 7029) as locally popular and vulnerable to flooding. Gives an Andhra Pradesh release in 1982.
